items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: he got Seth, Ike Robertson, Eddie Inson, Eddie Fant

ctx.x: And so, Joe -- I guess knowing that he was going to close the Sunset, he got Seth, Ike Robertson, Eddie Inson, Eddie Fant and Oliver -- Oliver Bibb or something. We had two Bibbs, now. We had two Bibbs, now. One of the Bibbs on -- Bibbs played a drum, but not that Bibb. I'm speaking about the bass player Bibbs. Bibbs on bass, and this tenor saxophone man. He wasn't in this band. His name is Jack Oldsby. Jack is passed now.
